root_cause: Self-serve SaaS checkout only offered paid sign-up. Arthur asked for a one month free variant on website and portal, as every SaaS has, to raise conversion. The earlier decision 'no trial in checkout' (mollie-afsluiten-koppeling) is superseded by this explicit request.
prevention: A 30 day trial without payment method runs through the same checkout (mode=trial) and the bg-mollie-checkout edge function: one trial per e-mail, status trialing, expiry by cron saas_expire_trials_v1, conversion on first paid payment reuses the same organisation. Netlify only forwards mode=trial; the portal shows days left and a pay-now link.

evidence.runtime_status: backend verified on production (start, duplicate guard, expiry); trial to paid conversion and website flow not yet verified end to end

limitations: Lifecycle e-mails (day 23, day 29, expiry) are a follow-up and need Arthur's approval of the copy
Mollie remains in test mode until go-live
Test rows from the backend verification remain in production (delete blocked)
